_: WHAT THIS IS. The current hero copy of 24 Vivid Smiles routes, in the exact characters each page renders today, ready to be typed into the ACF `hero` field group so the owner edits real words instead of blank boxes. Commit 68d80ac made the hero editable; this file is the content that fills it. Writing it changes no rendered pixel -- it moves the wording from the template literal into WordPress, where the template already prefers it. HOW IT WAS PROVED. Every value was read out of the BUILT HTML (dist//index.html), not the .astro source, then HTML-unescaped and .strip()ed to model the `.trim()` the loader applies at src/loaders/pages.ts:642-644. The payload was then injected locally through the hero surface behind an env var and the whole site rebuilt and diffed route by route against HEAD with scripts/vr-html.mjs. See the accompanying report for the per-route result. FIELD ABSENT = DELIBERATELY BLANK. A route that has no `eyebrow`, `sub` or `ctas` key is one where that box must be LEFT EMPTY in wp-admin; the template's own literal is the correct rendering and a stored value would be wrong. Reasons, per route: /services/ -- h1-only by contract; the page draws no hero band. /implant-dentistry/sinus-lift/ sub -- the rendered sub contains a real link. `sub` is plain text rendered as {hero.sub}, so storing it would publish visible <a ...> tags and destroy the link. Needs an HTML field, or the link has to leave the hero. /referral-program/ sub -- same problem: the rendered sub contains $50 credit. ctas on 23 of 24 routes -- the loader drops any CTA row missing either half (pages.ts:646) and the templates then read the survivors POSITIONALLY (hero.cta(0) is the solid button). Button 0 on nearly every hero is site data (bookNowHref / phoneHref), which src/blocks/cta.ts forbids storing, and the hero surface does not run resolveCtaHref, so a `book` token would emit href="book". Because slot 0 cannot be filled legally, slot 1 is unreachable: a payload holding only button 1 shifts it into slot 0 and repaints the primary button. All-or-nothing from index 0 down. /referral-program/ is the single exception -- its button 0 is the literal anchor #how-it-works, so it is stored, and button 1 is left to fall back. Making the rest editable is a change to the hero surface (a book/phone token resolved the way block CTAs already are), not to this file. `ratings` IS INCLUDED ON PURPOSE, though it is not hero copy. Filling `h1` flips `heroOn` true, and at that moment showRatings stops being unconditional and becomes the stored `ratings` boolean (src/lib/page-content.ts:312,339). 22 of these 24 routes draw a review line today; if the write leaves ratings off, all 22 lose it. It must be ON for every route here. (/contact/ and /services/ never draw the line, so the value is inert there -- set true for uniformity and to match the ACF default.) NO CREDENTIALS, NO SITE DATA. Every value is page copy. No phone number, booking URL, address or key appears anywhere in this file, by construction: the fields that would have carried them are the omitted ones above.

/cosmetic-dentistry/.sub:
If you've spent years hiding your smile, cosmetic dentistry at Vivid Smiles Dentistry
              in Parker offers a clear path to changing that. Dr. Bryce Richardson and Dr. Annelise
              Westermeier provide a full range of cosmetic treatments — from porcelain veneers and
              clear aligners to smile makeovers and gum contouring — with 600+ hours of specialized
              training and the technology to preview results before treatment begins.

/cosmetic-dentistry/clear-aligners/.sub:
Clear aligners are custom-made, removable plastic trays that shift teeth gradually
              into alignment, offering a nearly invisible alternative to traditional braces. Unlike
              metal brackets and wires, they come out for meals and daily brushing, and digital
              planning tools let you see your projected results before treatment begins. Here is
              what to expect from the process, who qualifies, and why Parker residents choose Vivid
              Smiles Dentistry for their clear aligner care.

/cosmetic-dentistry/porcelain-veneers/.sub:
Porcelain veneers are thin shells of dental porcelain bonded to the front of your
              teeth to correct discoloration, chips, gaps, and worn enamel. At Vivid Smiles
              Dentistry, Dr. Bryce Richardson specializes in no-prep and minimal-prep veneers that
              transform smiles while preserving natural tooth structure. Here is what the process
              looks like, how digital technology lets patients preview results first, and what sets
              this Parker practice apart.

/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening/.sub:
KöR professional whitening delivers reliable shade improvement for most patients,
              including those with difficult staining types that over-the-counter products cannot
              address. Unlike generic whitening systems, KöR uses refrigerated gels and continuous
              tooth contact to produce results that hold for years.

/cosmetic-dentistry/smile-makeover/.h1: Transform Your Smile with a Custom Smile Makeover in Parker, CO
/cosmetic-dentistry/smile-makeover/.sub:
A smile makeover combines two or more cosmetic treatments into one coordinated plan,
              designed to address your specific aesthetic concerns all at once rather than one
              procedure at a time. Unlike a single-service approach, it starts with the outcome you
              want and works backward to build the right treatment path. Here is what that process
              looks like at Vivid Smiles Dentistry, and what separates results that look natural
              from results that look obvious.

/cosmetic-dentistry/gum-contouring/.sub:
Gum contouring is a cosmetic dental procedure that reshapes excess or uneven gum tissue to reveal more
            of the natural tooth structure underneath. Laser technology makes the process precise and minimally
            invasive, with most patients experiencing little to no downtime. Here is who benefits, what the
            procedure involves, and how Dr. Bryce Richardson at Vivid Smiles Dentistry approaches gum reshaping
            as part of a complete smile design plan.

/cosmetic-dentistry/full-mouth-rehabilit.sub:
Full-mouth rehabilitation restores function, health, and appearance across multiple teeth in a single
            coordinated plan. Treatment combines whichever procedures each patient's condition requires: implants,
            crowns, bridges, veneers, or implant-supported dentures. Here is what to expect at Vivid Smiles
            Dentistry in Parker, Colorado.

/implant-dentistry/.sub:
Dental implants are the only tooth replacement that functions at the root level — preserving the
            jawbone and restoring full biting strength. Unlike bridges or dentures, implants fuse with the bone,
            making them a permanent solution rather than a prosthetic one. At Vivid Smiles Dentistry, Dr. Bryce
            Richardson places and restores implants entirely in-house with robotic guidance and full digital
            fabrication capability.

/implant-dentistry/all-on-4-single-arch/.h1: All-on-4 Single Arch Implants in Parker, Colorado
/implant-dentistry/all-on-4-single-arch/.sub:
All-on-4 single arch implants replace every tooth in one jaw, upper or lower, using
              four strategically placed titanium implants, and you leave the same day with a fixed,
              functional set of teeth. Unlike full-mouth treatment, single-arch All-on-4 targets one
              jaw, which means lower cost, a shorter procedure, and a focused treatment plan. Below
              is what the procedure involves, how robotic technology at Vivid Smiles Dentistry sets
              these outcomes apart, and what to expect from surgery through the final teeth.

/implant-dentistry/bone-grafting/.sub:
Bone grafting rebuilds jawbone lost after tooth extraction or gum disease, creating
              the foundation needed for dental implants. Without adequate bone volume, implants
              cannot anchor securely, which is why Dr. Richardson evaluates every patient with CBCT
              3D imaging before recommending treatment. Here is what bone grafting involves, who
              needs it, and what to expect at Vivid Smiles Dentistry in Parker.

/implant-dentistry/full-mouth-dental-imp.h1: Full Mouth Dental Implants in Parker, Colorado
/implant-dentistry/full-mouth-dental-imp.sub:
Full mouth dental implants replace an entire arch with a fixed, non-removable
              prosthesis supported by four to six titanium implants fused to the jaw. They function
              like natural teeth and preserve the bone that traditional dentures allow to erode.
              Below is what the procedure involves, who qualifies, and what to expect at Vivid
              Smiles Dentistry.

/implant-dentistry/single-tooth-dental-i.h1: Single Tooth Dental Implants in Parker, Colorado
/implant-dentistry/single-tooth-dental-i.sub:
A single tooth dental implant replaces a missing tooth with a titanium post and custom
              crown. It stands alone without altering adjacent teeth and preserves the jawbone
              beneath the gap. Below is how the process works at Vivid Smiles, how it compares to
              other replacement options, and who qualifies.

Vivid Smiles Dentistry provides general dentistry in Parker, covering preventive care,
